items.title: OpenAI may be in cost control mode
Kamil Khan Mumtaz: Pakistani architect, admired at home, almost invisible abroad
GPT-6.2 Astra users now hit limits 40% faster after OpenAI patched a pricing error
items.excerpt: OpenAI says a billing bug gave GPT-6.2 users incorrect discounts. After the fix, Astra and Sol users hit their limits 40 and 25 percent faster than last week. As an apology, subscribers get an extra reset, and business users get free Fast Mode through year-end. OpenAI is also testing a Chat and Work mode merger. items.title: Sakana AI Releases Namazu Small, a 30B Model Built on Nemotron 3 Nano
items.excerpt: Sakana AI released Sakana Namazu Small, a 30B-A3B reasoning model built on NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Nano. It averages 60.1 across 25 benchmarks, ahead of the 120B Nemotron 3 Super at 56.2. items.title: Former OpenAI researcher says the Riemann proof matters less than the fact that an AI system can produce it
items.excerpt: Complexity theorist and former OpenAI researcher Scott Aaronson argues that AI's recent math breakthroughs matter far beyond academia. The possible consequences, he writes, range from reshaping the global economy to threatening all life on Earth. He's also "virtually certain" that AI labs are sitting on "one or more bombshells" in cryptography.
